newsitem.title: DENMARK: SOCCER-DENMARK BEAT SLOVENIA 4-0 IN WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DENMARK BEAT SLOVENIA 4-0 IN WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: Denmark beat Slovenia 4-0 (halftime 2-0) in their World Cup Group One qualifier on Wednesday.
Allan Nielsen 4 56, Per Pedersen 28, Brian Laudrup 52.

Denmark - 1-Peter Schmeichel, 2-Jacob Laursen (15-Morten Bisgaard 58), 3-Marc Rieper, 4-Jess Hoegh, 5-Jan Heintze, 6-Thomas Helveg, 7-Allan Nielsen, 8-Claus Thomsen (13-Per Frandsen 86), 9-Jon Dahl Tomasson, 10-Per Pedersen (17-Mikkel Beck 70), 11-Brian Laudrup.

Slovenia - 1-Bosko Boskovic, 2-Robert Englaro, 3-Ales Krizan, 4-Darko Milanic, 5-Mladen Rodonja (16-Amir Karic 46), 6-Alfred Jermanis, 7-Doni Novak, 8-Damjan Gajser (15-Simon Seslar 60), 9-Ales Ceh, 10-Primoz Gliha, 11-Ermin Siljak (18-Sandi Valentincic 80).
